holds.raw: רבה בר יוסף אמר רב סוטה (ל' ע"א)
holds.reason: The checked Sotah folio reads Rav Assi or Rabbah ben Issi; Arakhin 5b gives Rabbah bar Yosef in a different report in Rav’s name. An apparatus suggests that Yosef in a manuscript’s variant may preserve this attribution. Exact Sotah witness collation is still outstanding.

notes.text: Sotah 30a gives Rav Assi or Rabbah ben Issi in the checked witness. Arakhin 5b attributes a different report to Rabbah bar Yosef. The reported Sotah variant awaits direct witness collation.
